meta.note: v6 (2026-09-18, phase B): refit to HaptiConnect replays of the logged raw Forza packets (true kerb and suspension values) and two new laps on a 9000-rpm car. Engine rpm/60 above 6800 rpm and within ~3% of it below (curve to 10000 rpm) at 0.158; gear shift an 80 ms square at rpm/120 (pitched mode); shift light 70 Hz; kerbs a 0.30 sine at 1.25 Hz per m/s; acceleration 58 Hz. Holdouts dist 3.30 -> 2.33 and 2.71 -> 2.21 (seeds 1 and 2). Applied by the maintainer's decision although two acceptance checks miss by hairlines (ACE level +0.13 dB, 70-100 Hz band 6 of 8 laps on seed 2). Reasons per change in the keys below.

meta.bedfit: suspension vel_hold_s/vel_curve/speed_floor_curve fitted by the maintainer's calibration notes (not published) to the 41.0 Hz line of HaptiConnect on fm_drive_1_hc, fm_drive_3_hc, fm_drive_4_hc, fm_drive_5_hc (holdout fm_drive_6_hc)
meta.shift_light_fit: shift_indicator re-measured on the phase B raw set (fm_drive_1/3/4/5_hc_raw, 8000-rpm car; fm_drive_7/8_hc, 9000-rpm car) by the maintainer's calibration notes (not published). HaptiConnect's shift light is a pure sine at 70.0 Hz (phase slope 70.00-70.02 Hz on fm1/4/5/8 and holdout fm6; 2nd harmonic ~1%), not 69 -> freq 70. It has NO throttle gate: on the 9000-rpm car it stays on at throttle 0 with rpm/max >= 0.86 (lift-offs and downshifts, 45 blocks at throttle < 0.2, all on at 0.38-0.40, still on 0.4-0.8 s after the lift) -> min_throttle 0.5 -> -1 (racing.py gates on throttle > min_throttle, so -1 = no gate). Unchanged: level 0.40 (HaptiConnect 0.40-0.41, ours reads 0.397) and the step at 0.842 +- 0.003 x max rpm on BOTH cars (6735 of 8000, 7575 of 9000 rpm; absolute rpm and max-minus-offset rejected), which the shipped 0.835->0.855 ramp already centres within that error
meta.engine_level: engine gain 0.175 -> 0.1646: HaptiConnect engine line measured flat 0.158 at every rpm and throttle on fm_drive_1/3/4/5/6_hc (the maintainer's calibration notes (not published)); ours read 0.168
meta.gear_shift_fit: rpm-pitched gear shift. On the raw set (the maintainer's calibration notes (not published)) HaptiConnect's shift burst is a square at rpm/120 Hz (pitch / (rpm/120) median 0.998, 21 of 24 driving shifts within 5 %), amplitude 0.317 (p10-p90 0.316-0.318), 80 ms per gear-byte change (it fires on both N->0 and 0->N+1), no 20 Hz floor (930 rpm plays 7.7 Hz, 714 rpm < 11 Hz), so pitch_hz_range [5, 120]. Gain 0.415 measured by rendering a synthetic shift through compare.render_offline (the same notes): plateau 0.763 x gain at 17-75 Hz -> 0.317. pitch_jitter and the template's freq/duration are unused in this mode.
meta.kerb_fit: Kerb cycle measured on the raw-packet training replays (fm_drive_1/3/4/5_hc_raw, fm_drive_7_hc, fm_drive_8_hc; tools in the maintainer's calibration notes (not published)). Pitch: 1.2506 +- 0.008 Hz per m/s (13 clean kerb runs, 7.7-61.2 m/s; the same notes), 77.2 Hz at 61.2 m/s, no cap, still 1.25 x speed at 7.2 Hz / 5.5 m/s: strip_hz_per_ms 1.25, strip_hz_max 100, strip_hz_min 6 kept. Waveform: pure sine (2nd/1st median 0.009, max 0.031; 3rd/1st 0.004), so wavetable_harmonics [1, .2, .45, .2, .15] -> [1.0]. Gate: the rumble_strip flags, not surface_rumble (no flag with 4 wheels on surface >= 1.4: 0.022 sine amplitude, flagged 0.25-0.47; the same notes), and the surface value on the kerb (0.24/1.5/2.6) does not set the level. Level: one sine per flagged wheel, 0.245 each (median of 32 single-wheel segments, IQR 0.228-0.265), flat with speed (0.25 at 8 m/s and at 61 m/s), each wheel with its own phase: a two-wheel segment reads |c_A + c_B| of its single-wheel neighbours (8 of 10 within 0.08, e.g. 0.237 vs 0.225 at -124 deg, 0.483 vs 0.481 at -35 deg; the same notes), relative phases spread over the circle, so two wheels give 0.02-0.53. Our wave mode gates on any wheel and cannot sum per-wheel phases, so the curve is flat at 1/sqrt(2) (unit-RMS sine table: sine amplitude = gain) and gain = the expected any-wheel level, 0.245 x sqrt(1.464 flagged wheels per kerb frame) = 0.30. The old curve (0.36 -> 0.15 RMS falling with speed, x1.05 gain, x1.24 fundamental) read 0.43 at 8 m/s and 0.22 at 47-49 m/s. Supersedes the road_level note (gain 1.05 was the stop-gap for this shape error). Code idea (not in this spec): per-wheel kerb sines (level ~ number of flagged wheels with independent phases).

HaptiConnect's engine line on the raw training set (fm_drive_1/3/4/5_hc_raw, fm_drive_7_hc, fm_drive_8_hc) sits at rpm/60 with no drop at high rpm: f/(rpm/60) median 0.9995-0.9997 in every 250-rpm bin 4000-8000 (16384-sample windows), 139.2 Hz at 8334 rpm (fm_drive_7_hc; the ~70 Hz shift light is a pure sine, 2nd harmonic -37 dB, so this is the engine), amplitude 0.158-0.161 at every rpm up to 8400 (the maintainer's calibration notes (not published)). Rows 1200-6640 rpm kept as shipped; the 880/1040-rpm rows 17.58 Hz -> rpm/60 (14.67, 17.33) plus rows at 560/720 rpm (9.33, 12.0): HaptiConnect plays 11.9 Hz at 715 rpm and 15.4 Hz at 924 rpm (f/(rpm/60) 0.999, amp 0.160, n=66/25 windows); 17.58 Hz is FFT bin 6 of a 16384 window at 48 kHz (a 15 Hz search floor), not a measured pitch; rpm/60 continued to 10000 rpm (extrapolated above 8400 rpm).

meta.impact_parity_fit: 2026-09-20 refit of the collision one-shot to HaptiConnect's own hit (scripts and outputs in the maintainer's calibration notes (not published)). SHAPE ONLY: impact.gain stays 0.9755, attack and release stay 0.002 / 0.004. HaptiConnect's extracted template sessions/_hc_templates/forza_motorsport/impact.wav is ONE cycle of a full-scale square - positive 0-10.0 ms, negative 10.0-19.8 ms (period 19.8 ms = 50.5 Hz), 18.7 ms at full scale (positive half 10.0 ms, negative 8.7 ms) plus a ~1.4 ms low-amplitude tail - so the profile template becomes a 50 Hz square one cycle long (0.020 s) instead of a 48 Hz saw 0.024 s long. Measured on all 21 collision triggers of the 8 raw-set references (the same notes) with windows that bracket the hit on both sides: HaptiConnect's own burst peak is searched +-200 ms around trigger + the lap's lag (its hit leads or lags that estimate by up to 80 ms; median -5 ms), our own shot is searched -20..+60 ms from its exact start, then both sides are measured the same way - 15-150 Hz excess over the local background in a +-90 ms window on each side's own peak, HaptiConnect's recording against OUR FULL MIX. HaptiConnect: -6 dB envelope width 20 ms, -20 dB 65 ms, zero-crossing rate 50 Hz, spectral peak 33.3 Hz, output peak 0.984 (its limiter ceiling). Shipped saw: width 10-12 ms, zcr 33 Hz, spectral peak 41.7 Hz, output peak 0.998, burst energy -2.11 dB training / -1.15 dB holdout / -1.99 dB over all 8 laps (median -2.08). New square: width 20 ms, zcr 50 Hz, output peak 1.000, burst energy -0.86 dB training / -0.47 dB holdout / -0.81 dB over all 8 laps (median -0.88); identical on seeds 1 and 2, and stable across window choices (HC search 100-200 ms, window 60-120 ms: base -1.6 to -2.1, candidate -0.5 to -0.9 dB). Averaged over the 8 laps the limiter now works about as hard as HaptiConnect's: driving samples above the 0.9 knee 0.030% -> 0.055% against HaptiConnect's 0.056%, but per lap the candidate is above HaptiConnect on 4 of the 8 (worst fm_drive_3_hc_raw 0.153% against 0.096%); the residual peak difference (1.000 vs 0.984) is our tanh ceiling against HaptiConnect's 0.985 limiter, a mixer question, not a level error. No other effect moves: paired intensity windows (the same notes, itable_base_s1/itable_final_s1) give 0.00 dB for engine, gear shift, shift light, kerb, road bed, acceleration, slip and lock; impact -3.29 -> -1.37 dB on that metric. Holdout Dist 2.315 -> 2.303 and 2.215 -> 2.160 with |level| 0.038 -> 0.031 and 0.238 -> 0.193; training mean Dist 2.566 -> 2.588 and fm_drive_3_hc_raw |level| +0.105 dB (we were already loud on the training laps, mostly from the road bed). Demo peak -10.17 dBFS, same as the shipped profile (limit -6). HaptiConnect plays a hit at all 21 of our triggers (output peak >= 0.976, median 0.985, against 1.9% of 480 random driving windows), so this level is not compensating for a detector error. The detector mismatch that remains - 6 full-scale HaptiConnect hits at moments where our long+lat rule fires nothing, 4 of them with a wheel on a kerb - is a code item, not a gain.
meta.applied: 2026-09-27 for release 1.0.0 from the maintainer's calibration notes (not published)
meta.shift_light_parity2_2026_09_22: the maintainer's calibration notes (not published) (scorer cache v6; every number is HaptiConnect vs OUR FULL MIX - the whole profile through one HapticEngine with the output limiter - same band and windows; seeds 1 and 2 identical). Built from the shipped profile with the same notes --spec candidates/forza_motorsport/parity2_shift_light.json. Three shift_indicator keys. (1) min_throttle 0.5 -> -1 (racing.py plays when throttle > min_throttle, so -1 = no gate): HaptiConnect plays the light at lift-off. 62-78 Hz level over every forward-gear lift-off on the light's plateau (rpm/max >= 0.86, throttle <= 0.5, >= 0.06 s; the same notes), median ours - HC: training 6 stretches (1.60 s, HC 0.36-0.43) -25.6 -> -0.1 dB; held out fm_drive_6_hc_raw 1 stretch (0.09 s) -8.4 -> +2.5 dB; ace_drive_3_hc and ace_drive_2_hc2 (ACE drives through HaptiConnect's Forza Motorsport plugin, never fitted) 7 stretches (2.64 s) -20.8 -> +0.2 dB. (2) min_gear 0 with below_min_gear_scale 0.001 (the level is scaled below gear 0, i.e. in reverse only): HaptiConnect has no 70 Hz light in reverse. A 70.0 Hz lock-in over each lit reverse stretch reads HC 0.0080 (fm_drive_1_hc_raw, 0.97 s) and 0.0028 (fm_drive_4_hc_raw, 0.50 s), inside the spread of HC's own readings at 60-80 Hz beside it (0.002-0.036 and 0.0004-0.030), and 0.0015 on ace_drive_3_hc (1.19 s, never fitted), where ours reads 0.0015 at this scale (0.40 before; scale 0.01 would read +8.7 dB there, 0.02 +14.5 dB; the same notes). The 66-74 Hz window measure (the same notes itable method) goes +20.1 -> -10.5 dB (training, n 11) and +29.4 -> -11.7 dB (cross-check, n 15): what remains is HaptiConnect broadband content (on the training laps also a 0.031-0.037 line at 66.7 Hz = max_rpm/120, cause unknown), not a light, so no scale was raised to fill it. 0.001 (-60 dB) rather than 0: racing.py's tone stops its phase at amplitude 0, so 0 would shift the phase (not the level) of every later light; with 0.001 the min_gear keys leave every forward-gear sample of all ten laps identical to the shipped profile (the same notes); the gate removal changes the lift-off moments and, through the same phase, the samples but not the level of later lights. Neutral keeps the light (min_gear 0, not 1): after the gear-shift burst HC's 62-78 Hz level in neutral is 0.31 (training, n 11) and 0.40 (cross-check, n 11), where light-on reads -0.2 / -0.3 dB and light-off -10.6 / -15.5 dB (the same notes); on the three reverse -> neutral transitions HC rises from 0.03-0.04 in reverse to 0.31-0.40 in neutral. EVIDENCE IS THIN for reverse: 2.2 s of lit reverse on two training laps and none on a held-out Forza Motorsport lap, so the reverse law is confirmed on ace_drive_3_hc (same plugin) and on the Forza Horizon plugin (fh5_drive_4_hc: HC 0.0048 at 70.0 Hz). Full-mix scores (Dist / level dB, shipped -> this file): fm_drive_1_hc_raw 1.661/-0.10 -> 1.771/-0.24, fm_drive_3_hc_raw 2.729/+0.16 unchanged, fm_drive_4_hc_raw 2.751/+0.63 -> 2.488/+0.40, fm_drive_5_hc_raw 2.540/+0.32 unchanged, fm_drive_7_hc 2.440/+0.18 -> 2.509/+0.31, fm_drive_8_hc 2.934/+0.59 -> 2.943/+0.61; held out fm_drive_6_hc_raw 2.288/-0.04 -> 2.250/-0.01, fm_drive_2_hc_raw 2.175/-0.26 unchanged; cross-check ace_drive_3_hc 2.722/-0.69 -> 2.410/-0.50, ace_drive_2_hc2 3.016/-0.77 -> 2.981/-0.75. Training mean Dist 2.509 -> 2.497, held-out mean 2.231 -> 2.212, held-out mean |level| 0.15 -> 0.14, cross-check mean 2.869 -> 2.695. The spectral part of Dist improves on every lap that changes; the fm_drive_1 and fm_drive_7 rises are their |level| term only (the reverse light was 0.15 dB of fm_drive_1's energy, a lap already under HaptiConnect; the lift-off light adds 0.13 dB to fm_drive_7, whose excess sits in the 9000-rpm car's road bed). Other effects: gear shift over all 246 shifts -0.19 -> -0.16 dB, impact over all 24 unchanged (the same notes). Demo unchanged: the same notes -7.82 dBFS on seeds 0-7 either way, the SafeLevelTests measure -8.20 dBFS with a -0.38 dB trim (the Demo script never lifts off above 0.835 x max rpm); the old lift-off + braking + downshift stress scene, not a Demo scene, reads -9.02 -> -5.90 dBFS at Demo scale.

probes.acceleration: ~60 Hz tone; on at ~3 m/s2 accelerating, ~7 braking, ~7 lateral; full scale within ~1-2 m/s2 (lower thresholds than the BeamNG plugin)
probes.collision: fixed ~45 ms hit 20-38 Hz on g jumps >= ~15 m/s2 held >= 3 frames, long or lat; speed drops alone ignored
probes.engine: tone at rpm/60 Hz, ~0.9 amplitude, no harmonics, throttle independent
probes.wheel_slip: band-limited: rear slip ratio ~0.5-1.3 or slip angle ~0.5-0.8 -> 54.5 Hz tone; larger values, front/all-wheel spin ignored
probes.rumble_strips: no response in either layout: non-functional
probes.shift_indicator: no response in either layout: non-functional
probes.wheel_lock: 56.4 Hz full-scale tone only when the FRONT wheels lock while the rears keep turning, under brake
probes.layout: this plugin decodes gear/pedals at the Forza HORIZON offsets; the 324-byte layout must be used
probes.gear_shift: 94 ms full-scale burst on every gear-byte change (Horizon layout); pure rpm drops ignored
probes.suspension: 41.2 Hz square wave, continuous; amplitude follows recent suspension velocity (1 s peak-hold): ~0.03 smooth, 0.08 at 15/s, 0.2 at 25+/s (strength 0.5)
probes.waveforms: engine, lock, acceleration: sine; suspension: square (h3 .33 h5 .2); gear shift: square-ish burst; slip: sine + small h3
probes.engine_lap: engine amplitude constant 0.159 on the lap regardless of throttle/speed/rpm/gear (strength 0.5)

analysis.strength_law: HaptiConnect effect strength 0.5 produced ~0.22 of the strength-1.0 amplitude (about -13 dB) on the real lap
analysis.rumble_strips: measured on real laps: HaptiConnect DOES render rumble strips (SurfaceRumble 1.5-2.6 + wheel flag): looped rough cycle at ~1.25 Hz per m/s capped ~42 Hz, rms ~0.3 falling to ~0.15 at high speed (strength 0.5); the earlier probe used SurfaceRumble <= 1.0 and never triggered it
analysis.suspension: 41.0 Hz square wave at all speeds; amplitude = max(curve(1 s peak susp velocity), low-speed floor(speed)); pooled from 5 Forza Motorsport laps (strength 0.5)
analysis.shift_indicator: on real laps: continuous ~66-70 Hz tone at full throttle, level ramps with rpm/max from ~0.78 (0.1) to 0.9+ (0.4) at strength 0.5; the synthetic probe never triggered it
analysis.gear_shift_lap: on laps HaptiConnect fires its ~94 ms burst on every gear-byte change (Forza passes through neutral -> two bursts ~220 ms), peak ~0.5-0.7 at strength 0.5, pitch randomized per trigger (p10 24, p50 51, p90 70 Hz)
